levels.surface: موسى بن جعفر بن وهب البغدادي

notes: Opens «وبهذا الإسناد»; prev1 writes a full chain, but how much of it this text takes over is not settled, so the back_reference is written as it stands and no names are inherited.
Maruf says «قلت لأبي جعفر الباقر»: the Imam is named in the words after the chain and is the last link (owner ruling 2).
